# Environment variables — `threat-intelligence-analyst`

<!-- generated by platform/scripts/gen_env_doc.py from distribution.yaml; do not edit by hand -->

`threat-intelligence-analyst` reads the following variables from its profile `.env` (generated as `.env.EXAMPLE` on install). All are credentials or endpoints — they are **never committed and never logged**. Set them in `.env`, then forward the names into the Kali sandbox via `docker_forward_env` in `config.yaml`.

## Reference

| Variable | Required | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `VIRUSTOTAL_API_KEY` | no | — | VirusTotal API key (read-only); hash/domain/IP/URL reputation lookups |
| `ABUSEIPDB_API_KEY` | no | — | AbuseIPDB API key (read-only); IP abuse-confidence reputation |
| `SHODAN_API_KEY` | no | — | Shodan API key (read-only); passive host/banner context for an IP |
| `OTX_API_KEY` | no | — | AlienVault OTX API key (read-only); pulses, IOCs, and feed subscriptions |
| `MISP_URL` | no | — | MISP instance base URL, e.g. https://misp.internal (read-only API user) |
| `MISP_API_KEY` | no | — | MISP automation key for a read-only user (search events/attributes) |
| `NVD_API_KEY` | no | — | Optional NVD API key (raises CVE-lookup rate limit 5->50/30s) |

## `.env` template

Copy into the profile's `.env` and fill real values (do not commit it):

```dotenv
# Other
VIRUSTOTAL_API_KEY=   # optional
OTX_API_KEY=   # optional
MISP_URL=   # optional
MISP_API_KEY=   # optional

# Threat-intel enrichment
ABUSEIPDB_API_KEY=   # optional
SHODAN_API_KEY=   # optional

# CVE research
NVD_API_KEY=   # optional
```

## Forward into the sandbox

Add the names (not values) to `config.yaml` so the Kali container sees them:

```yaml
terminal:
  docker_forward_env:
    - VIRUSTOTAL_API_KEY
    - ABUSEIPDB_API_KEY
    - SHODAN_API_KEY
    - OTX_API_KEY
    - MISP_URL
    - MISP_API_KEY
    - NVD_API_KEY
```

## Handling rules

- Credentials come **only** from these env vars — never hard-coded, printed, or committed (platform Security Policy).
- Prefer **read-only / least-privilege** credentials for every integration; forward names into the sandbox via `docker_forward_env`.
- Optional vars left unset simply disable or degrade the feature that needs them.
- Rotate any credential that may have been exposed; `.env` is in `.gitignore` and must stay untracked.
